route: 1: develop on all training data; confirm once on the sealed period only with the owner's separate approval; then forward paper trading
counts_note: candle-level conservative fills in development; no outcome read

setups.E1_order_block_after_break: order block whose impulse broke structure (BOS or CHoCH), displacement >= 1.5 ATR
setups.E2_fvg_displacement_1p5: fair value gap whose middle candle has range >= 1.5 ATR and a body >= 70% of its range
setups.E3_broken_level_retest: support/resistance band (levels refreshed weekly) broken by a close >= 0.25 ATR beyond it; limit at the broken edge
setups.E4_zone_pullback_d1_trend: demand (supply) zone with the D1 structure trend in the trade's direction
setups.E5_prev_day_sweep_reclaim: price trades beyond the previous New York day's low (high) and a candle of the same day closes back inside

main_setting.directions: long and short pooled; controls matched on direction

criteria: Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.10 over the tests run, edge > 0
mean R > 0 with $0.10 slippage per side
deflated Sharpe > 0.95 counting all trials of experiments 1-3
